pt-br:updateRecovery.cleanup-stopped.en: Murage is still finishing some background work. Your backup is kept.

pt-br:backup.waiting.interrupted.text: O Murage vai iniciar um novo backup sozinho em breve, para que suas alterações mais recentes também tenham backup.
pt-br:backup.waiting.interrupted.en: Murage starts a new backup by itself soon, so your latest changes get backed up.

pt-br:ux.d24.help.text: Leia as respostas concluídas em voz alta neste computador, na conversa aberta. Desativado durante chamadas. Requer um serviço de voz online.
pt-br:ux.d24.help.en: Read finished replies aloud on this computer, in the conversation you have open. Off while you are on a call. Needs an online voice service.

pt-br:ux.d24.failed.text: Não foi possível ler essa resposta em voz alta.

pt-br:ux.d24.hosted.text: Respostas em voz alta precisam de um serviço de voz online.
pt-br:ux.d24.hosted.en: Spoken replies need an online voice service.

zh:engines.copilot.preview.text: GitHub Copilot 通过你自己的 Copilot CLI（GitHub 用于输入命令的应用）运行，使用你的 GitHub 登录和 Copilot 套餐。GitHub 将 Murage 连接它的方式称为公开预览。
zh:engines.copilot.preview.en: GitHub Copilot runs through your own Copilot CLI, GitHub's app for typed commands, with your GitHub sign-in and Copilot plan. GitHub calls the way Murage connects to it a public preview.

zh:settings.l6.usage.plan.hint.text: 每个 AI 服务账户最近一次报告的套餐限额情况。
zh:settings.l6.usage.plan.hint.en: What each AI service account last reported about its plan limits.

zh:media.local.desktopOnly.text: 此处无法使用机器人文件夹中的图片。
zh:media.local.desktopOnly.en: Pictures from the bot's folder are not available here.

zh:call.budgetStop.text: 此 Flux 密钥已达到预算上限，因此通话已结束。预算重置或更改后，通话会重新开始。
zh:call.budgetStop.en: The call ended because this Flux key has reached its budget. It starts again when the budget resets or changes.

zh:setup.recommendedModel.text: 选择新模型时推荐使用：{model}。已保存的模型保持不变。
zh:setup.recommendedModel.en: Recommended for new choices: {model}. Your saved model stays as it is.

zh:updateRecovery.BACKUP_UPGRADE_STAGED.text: Murage 仍在安装更新。如果超过几分钟，请退出 Murage，打开“活动监视器”，选择 Murage 的 ShipIt 进程，然后选择“强制退出”。之后重新打开 Murage。你的备份会保留。
zh:updateRecovery.BACKUP_UPGRADE_STAGED.en: Murage is still installing the update. If this takes more than a few minutes, quit Murage, open Activity Monitor, select the process named ShipIt for Murage, and choose Force Quit. Then open Murage again. Your backup is kept.

zh:updateRecovery.BACKUP_UPGRADE_REVIEW_.text: 在 Murage 确认更新期间，本次检查让一切保持原样。请退出 Murage 并重新打开。如果再次出现此页面，请打开诊断文件夹并联系支持。你的备份会保留。
zh:updateRecovery.BACKUP_UPGRADE_REVIEW_.en: This check kept everything as it was while Murage confirms the update. Quit Murage and open it again. If this page comes back, open the diagnostics folder and contact support. Your backup is kept.

zh:updates.installerSteps.text: 下载 Murage {version}，然后把它拖到“应用程序”文件夹。你的聊天和设置都会保留。
zh:updates.installerSteps.en: Download Murage {version}, then drag it into Applications. Your chats and settings stay.

zh:updateRecovery.cleanup-stopped.text: Murage 仍在完成一些后台任务。你的备份会保留。
zh:updateRecovery.cleanup-stopped.en: Murage is still finishing some background work. Your backup is kept.

zh:backup.waiting.interrupted.text: Murage 很快会自动开始新的备份，让你最近的更改也得到备份。
zh:backup.waiting.interrupted.en: Murage starts a new backup by itself soon, so your latest changes get backed up.

zh:ux.d24.help.text: 在此电脑上朗读当前打开的对话中已完成的回复。通话期间关闭。需要在线语音服务。
zh:ux.d24.help.en: Read finished replies aloud on this computer, in the conversation you have open. Off while you are on a call. Needs an online voice service.

zh:ux.d24.hosted.text: 朗读回复需要在线语音服务。
zh:ux.d24.hosted.en: Spoken replies need an online voice service.
